suggested_wording: To exercise this right, submit a privacy request using one of the channels listed on this page. If you need to opt out of profiling that is used for decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects, please email [email protected] with the subject line 'Privacy Request'. Alternative channels described on this page, including the GPC signal or the Section 9 procedures, may also be used to submit your request. This is a draft for internal review and may require further refinement to meet applicable law.

To opt out of targeted advertising, please email info@torusvotersystems.com with a request to opt out of targeted advertising. We will verify your identity and process your opt-out request within 30 days of receipt. You will receive confirmation once the opt-out has been completed.

You have the right to request a portable, readily usable copy of the personal data we hold about you when the data is digitally available and technically feasible to transfer. If feasible, we will provide the data in a commonly usable format that you can take to another service. To exercise this right, please contact us at info@torusvotersystems.com. We will respond to verified requests within 30 days.

Texas residents have the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. To exercise this right, please email info@torusvotersystems.com with a request to opt out of profiling in these contexts. We will acknowledge your request and provide any required follow-up steps. This opt-out applies to profiling used in decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects.

Texas residents may request deletion of personal data we hold about them, including data you provided and data we obtained from other sources. To exercise this right, please submit a deletion request through [REQUEST FORM URL] or email [PRIVACY EMAIL]. We may verify your identity to protect your information, and we will process your request as permitted by applicable law.

To exercise your right to correct inaccurate personal data, please submit a correction request using our [REQUEST FORM URL] or email [PRIVACY EMAIL]. Please include a description of the data to be corrected and why the correction is needed, and we will assess the request in light of the data type and the purposes for which we process the data. You may exercise your rights directly or through an authorized agent.

Texas residents have the right to obtain a portable, readily usable copy of personal data you provided us when the data is digitally available and technically feasible. To exercise this right, please submit a request using [REQUEST FORM URL] or by emailing [PRIVACY EMAIL]. For your protection, we may require identity verification before processing your request. If feasible, we will provide the data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and transmit it to you or to another entity you designate.

If you do not want us to process your personal data for targeted advertising, you can opt out using the opt-out form at the top of this page. In the form, select the option related to targeted advertising to stop that processing. This opt-out is part of our existing overall opt-out process for personal data handling. If you need help locating the option, you can use the web form on this page for assistance.

You have the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about you. To exercise this right, submit a profiling opt-out request using the existing web form and choose the profiling opt-out option in the form. If you need assistance, you can use the web form you already see on this page to contact us.

To exercise your right to delete personal information we maintain about you, please submit a deletion request using one of our channels below. You may email privacy@5x5coop.com or use our web form at https://privacy.5x5data.com/5×5/opt-out to start the deletion process. We will verify your identity as needed and delete the data we are required to delete under applicable law, and we will respond with the outcome of your request.

To request a portable copy of the personal data you provided, please submit a Data Portability request using one of the channels listed on this page. You may email privacy@5x5coop.com or use our web form to start the request. We will respond with the next steps and, when technically feasible, provide the data in a portable, readily usable format that you can transmit to another party.

Texas law gives you the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. To exercise this right, you may submit a request through the web form at https://privacy.5x5data.com/5×5/opt-out or by emailing privacy@5x5coop.com with a request to opt out of profiling for such decisions. We will handle your request in accordance with applicable law and will confirm the outcome after processing.

Under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act, you have the right to request deletion of personal data we hold about you. To exercise this right, you may either log into your account and submit a deletion request, or email abcms21@aol.com with your request. We will review your deletion request in light of TDPSA and any applicable exemptions and will notify you of our decision. If certain data must be retained to comply with law or for legitimate business purposes, we will explain which data cannot be deleted and why.

To opt out of the sale of your personal data, please email abcms21@aol.com with 'Opt out of sale' in your message. We will process your opt-out request and confirm when it has been applied. If you need assistance, you can contact us at the same email address.

To opt out of processing your data for targeted advertising, email abcms21@aol.com with 'Opt out of targeted advertising' in the subject line and include a brief statement that you wish to opt out. We will process opt-out requests submitted through this channel and stop targeted advertising for you for future processing. If you need help, reply to that email or contact us using the same channel.

Texas law gives you the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about you. To exercise this right, email abcms21@aol.com with the subject 'Opt-Out of Profiling' and include a brief description of the profiling activity you want to opt out of. We will acknowledge your request and respond with any next steps.

Texas residents have the right to request correction of personal data that is inaccurate or incomplete. To submit a correction request, please use the existing web form on this page to describe the data and the corrections you want made. We will review your request and update the records as appropriate and notify you of the outcome.

Under Texas law, you have the right to opt out of profiling when profiling is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about you. To exercise this right, submit a profiling opt-out request through the existing web form and select the option in the Request Type field that covers opt-out of profiling for significant decisions. This clarification helps distinguish this right from general profiling opt-outs and ties it to decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

Texas residents have the right under TDPSA §541.051(b)(3) to request deletion of personal data about them. To exercise this right, please submit a deletion request using our web form at https://app.intentsify.io/opt-out. We will review the request and delete the data where required by TDPSA, following our procedures for this right. If you need help with the form, please use the same web form to contact us.

Texas residents have the right to confirm whether we process their personal data and to access the data we hold about them. To exercise these rights, submit a request through our web form at https://app.intentsify.io/opt-out.

Texas residents have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal data we maintain about you under the TDPSA. To exercise this right, submit a correction request using the web form. We will review the request in light of the data type and the purposes for which we process the data and will make corrections when appropriate; we may ask for additional information to complete the correction.

Texas residents have the right to obtain a portable copy of the personal data you provided to us, in a readily usable digital format, when such data is available to us and technically feasible. To exercise this right, please submit your request using the web form at https://app.intentsify.io/opt-out. We will respond through the available channel and provide the data in a portable format if feasible.

Texas residents have the right to request deletion of personal information that we have collected about them or that we obtain from other sources, subject to TDPSA exceptions. To exercise this right, please submit your deletion request using [REQUEST FORM URL] or by emailing [PRIVACY EMAIL]. We may verify your identity to protect your privacy, and we will process your deletion request in accordance with TDPSA.

Texas residents have the right to confirm whether we process their personal data and to access the personal data we hold about them. To exercise these rights, submit a verifiable request at [REQUEST FORM URL] or email [PRIVACY EMAIL]. We will verify your identity as required by law and respond to your request under TDPSA.

Texas residents have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal information we maintain about them, in a manner that reflects the data’s nature and how we use it under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act. To exercise this right, please submit a correction request through [REQUEST FORM URL] or contact us at [PRIVACY EMAIL]. We will review your request and respond within a reasonable timeframe, and we may ask you for additional information to verify your identity. If we cannot correct the information, we will provide an explanation and outline any available next steps.

Texas residents have the right to obtain a portable copy of personal data you provided to us, to the extent the data is stored digitally and can be readily transferred. To exercise this right, submit a data-portability request using [REQUEST FORM URL] or contact [PRIVACY EMAIL]. We will assess the request and provide the data in a portable, readily usable format when it is digitally available and technically feasible to disclose. This right is subject to applicable Texas law and our data-processing practices.

Texas residents have the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. To exercise this right, use the AdChoices icon and follow the profiling opt-out steps, or use WebChoices to place an opt-out cookie. You may also submit a Texas-specific profiling opt-out request via [REQUEST FORM URL] or [PRIVACY EMAIL].

Texas residents may request confirmation of whether we process their personal data and access the data we hold about them. To exercise this right, use one of our approved channels: the privacy-consumer-requests web form at privacy.forian.com or via https://forian.com/privacy-consumer-requests/, or call our toll-free number 1-888-770-2072. When submitting, please provide enough information to verify your identity and locate your data (for example, your name and a way for us to contact you) and indicate that you are requesting confirmation of processing and a copy of your personal data. We will respond through the same channel you used to submit your request and provide the data we hold, as required by applicable law.

Texas residents have the right to request correction of inaccurate Personal Data we hold about them under TDPSA. To exercise this right, please submit a correction request through our Texas-specific process using one of these channels: the web form at privacy.forian.com, the web form at https://forian.com/privacy-consumer-requests/, or by calling toll-free 1-888-770-2072. In your request, describe the data to be corrected and the correction you are seeking, and include enough information for us to locate the data and understand the processing purposes. We will assess your request taking into account the nature of the data and the purposes for which we process it.

Texas residents have the right to obtain a portable, readily usable copy of personal data we have processed, when such data is available digitally and technically feasible to provide. To exercise this right, you can submit a request through our privacy-consumer-requests page at privacy.forian.com or via the form at https://forian.com/privacy-consumer-requests/; you may also contact us by toll-free phone at 1-888-770-2072. We will respond in accordance with TDPSA requirements and provide the data in a portable format when feasible.

Texas residents have the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. To exercise this right, please submit a profiling opt-out request through our privacy-consumer-requests web form at privacy.forian.com or via the form at https://forian.com/privacy-consumer-requests/, or call toll-free 1-888-770-2072. We will review your request and apply the opt-out as required by TDPSA.

If you want us to delete your personal data, please submit a deletion request using the existing rights-request web form. In the form, select the Deletion option and follow the prompts to identify the data to be removed. If you need help, you can reach our privacy team at [PRIVACY EMAIL].

To exercise the Texas sale opt-out right, submit a sale opt-out request using our web form at [REQUEST FORM URL]. After you submit, you will receive a confirmation by the email address you provided in the form. We will process your opt-out request in accordance with applicable privacy laws and our data-processing policies. If you need help, the form will guide you through the required information we need to complete your request.

To exercise your right to opt out of targeted advertising, please submit a targeted advertising opt-out request using the existing privacy web form on this site. If the form includes a dedicated option for targeted advertising, select it and provide any required identifying information to verify your request; if not, please indicate in the description field that you are exercising your right to opt out of targeted advertising. You will receive a response to the email address you provide in the form.

To exercise data portability, you can submit a data portability request using the existing rights form by selecting Data portability as the request type. Please indicate the specific data you want copied and, if you have a preferred format, note that in your request. We will provide the portable copy in a readily usable form when the data is digitally available and technically feasible.

You have the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. To exercise this right, please submit a profiling opt-out request through the rights-request web form on this page and indicate that you want to opt out of profiling for those decisions. This opt-out applies to profiling used for significant effects, not to all profiling activities. We will review and process your request in accordance with the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act via the existing rights-request channel.

Texas residents have the right to obtain a portable, readily usable copy of personal data you previously provided, when the data is available digitally and technically feasible to provide. To exercise this right, please submit a data portability request using our existing channels: the web form (OneTrust) or by phone at +1-888-799-0566. If you are submitting through an authorized agent, provide written permission and verify your identity; you may also use designated authorized-agent submission with the required authorizations.

You have the right to opt out of profiling that is used to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about you. To exercise this right, please submit a profiling opt-out request using our web form at https://app.commonroom.io/remove-my-info. We will review your request and respond in accordance with applicable law.

Texas residents have the right to know whether we process their personal data and to access that data. To exercise this right, submit a request using the privacy choices link on this Application or by contacting the Owner through the contact details provided in this document. If you are filing under TDPSA, please indicate 'TDPSA' in your request so it can be routed accordingly.

To exercise your right to opt out of profiling used for decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects, please use the privacy choices link on this Application. If you are unable to access that link, you may contact the Owner using the contact details provided in this document to request an opt-out. We will process your opt-out request in accordance with applicable law and will confirm once the opt-out has been applied.

To request a correction, submit your request through the Contact Us channel described in the Contact Us section below. Please include a description of the information you want corrected and why you believe it is inaccurate, and attach documentation that verifies your identity and supports the proposed correction. We will consider the nature of the data and the purposes for processing when reviewing your correction request.

Texas residents may request a portable, readily usable copy of personal data we provided to you, to the extent the data is digitally available and technically feasible. To request this, please email privacy@sproutsocial.com and indicate that you are requesting data portability under Texas law. We will respond with any required steps and provide the portable copy if it is available digitally; if not, we will explain why and outline any alternatives allowed by law.
